title: Non-atomic session and chat-history persistence
scope: Application-process crash consistency and truthful recovery in the supported single typed-server process topology.

ownership.schema: SessionFile version 1; accepted legacy shape migrates atomically

ownership.additional_writer: Local provider-export import through the same ChatStore
ownership.schema: Strict ChatHistoryResponse shape without an explicit version field

baseline_failure.reproduction: Interrupted in-place write against disposable fixture left canonical bytes as {; JSON.parse failed.

atomicity_contract.replacement: Same-directory rename on tested Windows NTFS
interruption_points: Partial temporary write: old canonical remains valid
Complete temporary before rename: old canonical remains valid
Immediately after rename: new canonical is complete and valid

concurrency.lock: Normalized canonical path transaction mutex within one Node process
concurrency.standard_topology: One typed ArchServer per workspace under scripts/start.mjs
concurrency.cross_process_coordination: UNSUPPORTED; no OS lock or compare-and-swap

recovery.condition: Missing file in usable existing workspace

recovery.result: CORRUPT_STATE; preserve bytes; NOT_READY route response
READ_FAILED; do not report empty state
Ignore at startup; remove only helper-named files older than 24 hours after a later successful commit
No backup is created or consumed

write_failures.diagnostics: Sanitized state kind, reason, operation phase, optional OS code, and recovery action; no state content or absolute path

failures: POST /api/providers/import authority matrix timed out at 5.456 seconds against its fixed 5-second fixture deadline
ENOTEMPTY teardown on the same provider-routes fixture after timeout
full_npm_check.classification: Load-sensitive timing is supported by isolated/full-run contrast; exact host cause is not proven. Full canonical check remains failed overall.

workflow_handoff_continuation.evidence: Earlier targeted run; the full architecture run after the final source change had no failures in these suites.

limits: No cross-process coordination for multiple typed servers sharing a workspace.
No last-known-good backup or automatic recovery from malformed canonical state.
Filesystem failures were injected; no real disk-full event was induced.
Provider-export import is per-conversation and non-transactional.
Provider import matrix is close to its 5-second test deadline and timed out at 5.456 seconds in the full architecture run.
